entries.title: Walk the Line
entries.summary: Reese Witherspoon won the Academy Award for Best Actress as June Carter Cash opposite Joaquin Phoenix, performing all vocals live.

entries.summary: The defining comedy of her career: Elle Woods takes Harvard Law School and becomes a global pop-culture icon.

entries.summary: Voice role as Rosita in Illumination's animated musical hit.

entries.title: Freeway

entries.summary: Cult psychological thriller opposite Mark Wahlberg.

entries.title: Rendition
